Compiti: In questo ruolo, si costruirà il ponte tra ricerca e processo decisionale: Si condurrà progetti basati su prove. tra cui letteratura :14s e meta-analisi. e preparare i risultati scientifici in modo che saranno utilizzati per la progettazione politica, l'amministrazione e la pratica. descriptionByLocale.en:
As the largest university in Switzerland, the University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various fields of study and career. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional profiles for learners, the University offers an inspiring working environment in top research and education. Use your talent and skills with us. Learn more about the UZH as an employer! Tasks: In this role, you will build the bridge between research and decision-making: You will conduct evidence-based projects – including literature :14s and meta-analyses – and prepare scientific findings in such a way that they will be used for political design, administration and practice. Your work will thus have immediate social relevance. You are embedded in a dedicated team led by Dr. Doris Hanappi and Prof. Moritz M. Daum. Your tasks
• Support in the search, coding and evaluation of research literature
• Cooperation in the preparation of evidence synthesis in the field of education
• Cooperation in the development of a new evidence tool
• Support in scientific analyses and reports on evidence tool The evidence tool is a platform available worldwide to help find, merge and use research results from the field of education more easily and quickly for decision-making. For more information, please contact: https://jacobs Foundation.org/Fry/synthesis-ready-ev-site-repository/. Requirements:
• Completed studies in psychology, sociology, educational sciences, economics or other relevant disciplines of social, educational and behavioural sciences
• Interest or initial experience in empirical research
• Interest in carrying out systematic literary reviews
• Joy in application-oriented work, especially in Switzerland
• Structured and reliable working methods
• Native German knowledge, high text security in German and English We offer: Our employees benefit from a wide range of and attractive offers. For more information, see: https://www.uzh.ch/en/explore/work.html

descriptionByLocale.it:

Compiti: In questo ruolo, si costruirà il ponte tra ricerca e processo decisionale: Si condurrà progetti basati su prove. tra cui letteratura :14s e meta-analisi. e preparare i risultati scientifici in modo che saranno utilizzati per la progettazione politica, l'amministrazione e la pratica. Il vostro lavoro avrà quindi immediata rilevanza sociale. Siete incorporati in un team dedicato guidato dal Dr. Doris Hanappi e Prof. Moritz M. Daum. I vostri compiti

descriptionByLocale.en:
As the largest university in Switzerland, the University of Zurich offers a wide range of attractive positions in various fields of study and career. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional profiles for learners, the University offers an inspiring working environment in top research and education. Use your talent and skills with us. Learn more about the UZH as an employer! Tasks: In this role, you will build the bridge between research and decision-making: You will conduct evidence-based projects – including literature :14s and meta-analyses – and prepare scientific findings in such a way that they will be used for political design, administration and practice. Your work will thus have immediate social relevance. You are embedded in a dedicated team led by Dr. Doris Hanappi and Prof. Moritz M. Daum. Your tasks
• Evaluate and summarize research literature
• Create evidence synthesis for research, policy and practice
• Work on developing a new evidence tool
• Support for scientific analyses and evidence tool reports The evidence tool is a platform available worldwide to help find, merge and use research results from education more easily and quickly for decision-making purposes. Further information - https://jacobs Foundation.org/ Animation/synthesis-ready-evidence-repository/. Requirements:
• Completed studies in psychology, sociology, educational sciences, economics or other relevant disciplines of social, educational and behavioural sciences
• Initial experience in empirical research and literature databases
• Interest in methods of evidence synthesis (e.g. systematic reviews, meta-analyses)
• joy in application-oriented work, especially in Switzerland
• structured and reliable working methods
• native German knowledge, high text security in German and English We offer: Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. Find out more at: https://www.uzh.ch/en/explore/work.html.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The University of Zurich, Switzerland's largest university, offers a range of attractive positions in various subject areas and professional fields. With around 10,000 employees and currently 12 professional apprenticeship streams the University offers an inspiring working environment on cutting-edge research and top-class education. Put your talent and skills to work with us. Find out more about UZH as an employer! Aufgaben: The positions are well-suited for BA or Master's program graduates who wish to gain firsthand experience in research before entering a PhD program. Applicants from outside the EU should have a minimum Master's degree. Former predocs have joined doctoral programs or research labs at Berkeley, MIT, Chicago, Harvard, Princeton, Yale, UBC, Oxford, and LSE. We are particularly interested in people with a strong quantitative background, statistical skills (STATA), experience in computer programming (Python), web scraping, text2data, AI (LLMs), and/or the use of geographical data for quantitative analysis. Curiosity and energy matter to us as much as initiative and attention to detail. Anforderungen:
• University degree in a relevant discipline (economics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, economic history)
• Postgraduate qualifications (MA/MSc/MPhil) or a BA with an outstanding record
• Excellent research and analytical skills
• Good knowledge of STATA, ARC-GIS, Matlab, Python preferred, but not strictly necessary What we offer
• Interesting and intellectually challenging work
• On-the-job training of research skills
• Competitive salary
• Travel opportunities
• Help and advice with PhD program placements Place of work The position is based in Zurich. Start of employment Appointments for one year in the first instance with starting date of 1st of July 2026 or as close as possible to this date and may be renewed. A willingness to stay for a second year is a plus. For further information about our research and the Department of Economics please see: J. Voth and ECON . Wir bieten: Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers. More

Aufgaben:
Sie verfolgen die (hochschul-)politischen Entwicklungen auf kantonaler und nationaler Ebene und sorgen mit Analysen, Präsentationen und Stellungnahmen dafür, dass die UZH ihre Interessen gezielt in die politischen und fachlichen Debatten einbringen kann. Sie organisieren politische Besuche und Veranstaltungen an der UZH und unterstützen den Rektor bei seinen Auftritten in Kommissionen und Fraktionen des Zürcher Kantonsrats. Darüber hinaus sind Sie in Rücksprache mit den entsprechenden Expert*innen für die Beantwortung von parlamentarischen Vorstössen und das Verfassen von Stellungnahmen zuständig und übernehmen weitere Aufgaben im Stab des Generalsekretariats.

Anforderungen:
• abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium mit sehr gutem Leistungsausweis

• einige Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise im Bildungsbereich oder der öffentlichen Verwaltung

• ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der politischen Systeme und des Geschehens im Kanton Zürich und in der Schweiz

• fundierte Kenntnisse im (internationalen) Hochschulwesen

• fehlerfreies und stilsicheres Deutsch (Muttersprache) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil

• selbständige, sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise – auch unter Zeitdruck
